sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: A shrub of humid tropical forests from southeastern Mexico to Honduras. The references consulted do not provide a reliable height.

sections.title: Leaves and flowers
sections.text: The opposite leaves are toothed and paler, sometimes downy, beneath. The bisexual flowers have ten stamens; the dry fruit opens into follicles.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: No food use or species-specific toxicity was found in the sources consulted.
